articles.title: At AI Summit, South Korea Outlines Its AI Future With NVIDIA and Partners
articles.summary: At this week’s AI Summit in San Francisco, South Korean President Jae Myung Lee and some of the country’s top business leaders and researchers are meeting with NVIDIA and ecosystem partners to chart Korea’s AI progress.
